gui.blackbox.handbook.title: Blackbox Handbook
gui.blackbox.handbook.subtitle: Field Manual
gui.blackbox.handbook.section.start.tool: Setup and connect a farm cell
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.0.title: Create a Farm Cell
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.0.body: Place a Dimensional Workbench, insert a Dimension Core and give it a clear name. Every core starts with a free 1x1 cell. Cell-size, environment and mob-spawn upgrades must be applied before the first visit.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.0.tip: Entering an active farm cancels its measurement and opens it for editing.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.1.title: Connect Resources
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.1.body: Blue Farm Inputs receive items, fluids and energy from the workbench. Green Farm Outputs return products automatically. You may place several Outputs; all of them are collected and measured together.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.1.tip: Output contents remain in place whenever the workbench has no free capacity.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.2.title: Record Production
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.2.body: Leave through dimensional bedrock when the farm is ready. After internal preparation, every inventory, tank, energy store, Output and persistent mob is compared for the configured measurement duration.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.2.tip: The farm chunks stay ticking and unfinished measurements survive restarts.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.3.title: Recalculate Safely
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.3.body: During a new measurement, the matching core pauses in every Workbench and Blackbox. Existing farm Output contents are moved back first. The new profile replaces the old one only after a valid result is complete.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.3.tip: The hidden preparation phase is never included in production totals.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.4.title: Simulation and Stability
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.4.body: A programmed core simulates in either machine. Without Stability, measured peaks are randomly shifted each cycle while totals stay exact. Stability distributes each resource evenly across the cycle.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.4.tip: Hold Shift over a programmed core to inspect rates and required inputs.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.5.title: Mob Inputs
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.5.body: Persistent mobs that disappear are recorded as inputs. Natural mobs and spawner mobs with an active spawner are ignored. Final counts use ten snapshots, preventing brief boundary movement from becoming a false cost.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.5.tip: Drive an occupied boat or minecart near a machine to supply a required mob.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.6.title: Blueprint Library
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.6.body: Right-click blue Blueprint paper to open the library. Local templates are the default and work across worlds and servers. Select, rename, revise or delete them; operators may publish copies to the server library.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.6.tip: An empty core transports an occupied vehicle into the cell for building.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.7.title: Server Administration
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.7.body: The Admin Book manages blocked farm blocks, registered cells and the measurement duration used by future recordings. Only operators can open it. Active measurements keep the duration they started with.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.7.tip: Warmup remains an internal server setting and is not shown to players.
